_comment: Rules for `pmmod strings fasttext`. Each rule matches text in the client's own dumps; every match is replaced with an escaped newline so the box advances immediately. Keep rules narrow: silencing a prompt still shows its Yes/No box, but silencing quest directions loses information you may need.

rules.name: pokecenter
rules.match: restore your tired|We hope to see you again|Welcome to our POK|Thank you for waiting|We've restored your|take your POK[^ ]*MON for a few seconds|Your POK[^ ]*MON are fighting fit

rules.name: mart
rules.note: Shop clerk purchase and sale flow
rules.match: Anything else\?|Here you are! Thank you|Thank you very much!|Welcome!\\nHow may I serve you|Please come again|How many would you like

rules.name: daycare
rules.note: Day-care deposit, retrieval and egg hand-off
rules.match: DAY.?CARE|Take good care of it|found an EGG|got an EGG|raise one of\\nyour POK|We can raise

rules.name: fishing
rules.match: Not even a nibble|Looks like there's nothing here|A bite!|Oh! A bite

rules.name: hm-field-moves
rules.note: Cut / Surf / Strength / Rock Smash / Waterfall prompts
rules.match: used CUT|used SURF|used STRENGTH|used ROCK SMASH|used WATERFALL|used FLASH|used DIVE|would like to SURF|Do you want to use

rules.name: status-battle
rules.note: Battle status spam: faint, paralysis, burn, sleep, confusion, recoil
rules.match: fainted!|is paralyz|was burned|was frozen|fell asleep|is confused|flinched|hurt by|restored health|is fast asleep|snapped out of

rules.name: shop-extra
rules.match: Thank you\.|Come again|That will be|Is that OK\?

rules.name: catch-flow
rules.note: Ball throw result -- fires on every encounter you throw at
rules.match: Gotcha!|was caught!|The POK[^ ]*MON broke free|Aww! It appeared to be caught

rules.name: move-learned
rules.note: Move learned on level-up (not the forget prompt)
rules.exclude: wants to learn|Forget a move|Stop learning|Delete a move

never: raising its |Raises the |lowers the |inflict damage|An item to be held|A Pok[eé] Ball|Use it to flee|It is designed|restores? \d|An item for use on a POK|The user |A move that
_never_comment: Global guard. Item and move descriptions are read on purpose, never mashed through -- 966 entries and ~96k characters in this corpus. No rule may silence them, however tempting the volume.
